{{CharInfobox |color={{contest color}} |corecolor={{contest color light}} |bordercolor={{contest color dark}} |name=Jeremy |jname=オガタ |tmname=Ogata |slogan=no |image=Jeremy AG151.png |size=220px |caption=Jeremy |gender=Male |colors=yes |eyes=Green |hair=Brown |hometown={{ka|Silver Town}} |region=[[Kanto]] |relatives={{OBP|Mandy|AG151}} (wife), {{OBP|Nicholas|AG151}} (son) |trainer=yes |trainerclass={{pkmn|Coordinator}} |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=AG151 |epname=Weekend Warrior |enva=[[Craig Blair]] |java=Hidenari Ugaki }} '''Jeremy''' (Japanese: '''オガタ''' ''Ogata'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|AG}}. ==History== [[File:Jeremy youth.png|left|thumb|220px|Jeremy in his youth]] Jeremy first appeared in ''[[AG151|Weekend Warrior]]''. He is a businessman who was a traveling rocker in his youth. Before that, he was a [[Pokémon Trainer]], but he was forced to quit when he formed his band since he became busy. He had a lifelong dream of entering a [[Pokémon Contest]]. He donned his rocker persona again, and entered the {{ka|Silver Town}} Contest. He used his {{p|Butterfree}} during the [[Appeal|Appeals Round]], where it used a [[Contest combination|combination]] of {{m|Stun Spore}}, {{m|Poison Powder}}, and {{m|Safeguard}}. His wife {{OBP|Mandy|AG151}} and son {{OBP|Nicholas|AG151}} interrupted his appeal to convince him to give up his dream and come home. Jeremy replied with a speech about how he and his Pokémon spent countless hours {{pkmn|training}} to achieve their dream and what it means to be a [[Pokémon Coordinator]]. After this speech, the judges, audience members, and {{an|May}} cheered him on to continue competing. After seeing what this dream means to him, his family let him finish his run in the Silver Contest. Jeremy and his {{p|Venusaur}}, who was usually sleeping according to Nicholas, ended up battling against May and her {{TP|May|Combusken}} in the final round. Venusaur launched its powerful {{m|Frenzy Plant}} attacks, but in the end, May won the [[Ribbon]]. Jeremy briefly reappeared in ''[[AG181|Thinning the Hoard!]]'', where he was seen watching the [[Kanto Grand Festival]] at home with his wife and son. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} The listing is of Jeremy's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Jeremy |pkmn=Venusaur |stage1=Ivysaur |type1=Grass |type2=Poison |img=Jeremy Ivysaur.png |cap=Jeremy's Ivysaur |img2=Jeremy Venusaur.png |epnum=AG151 |epname=Weekend Warrior |vaen=Craig Blair |desc=Jeremy used {{p|Venusaur}} during the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]] of the Silver Contest. It was able to get him past many opponents and went up against May and her Combusken in the final round. After a long battle, it was narrowly defeated as May's Combusken only had a point left on the bar shown on the screen. In Jeremy's flashback of his youth, it was revealed that he owned Venusaur when it was an {{p|Ivysaur}}. Venusaur reappeared in ''[[AG181|Thinning the Hoard!]]'', where it was seen watching the [[Kanto Grand Festival]] at home with its Trainer and his family. Venusaur's known moves are {{m|Vine Whip}}, {{m|Razor Leaf}}, and {{m|Frenzy Plant}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Jeremy |pkmn=Butterfree |type1=Bug |type2=Flying |img=Jeremy Butterfree.png |epnum=AG151 |epname=Weekend Warrior |desc={{p|Butterfree}} was used in the Appeals Round where it made some dazzling appeals until Jeremy got interrupted by his wife and son. However, May supported him to keep going. Despite the interruption, Jeremy was able to go on to the next round thanks to Butterfree's performance. Butterfree's known moves are {{m|Poison Powder}}, {{m|Stun Spore}}, and {{m|Safeguard}}.}} ==Contests== Jeremy has competed in the following [[Pokémon Contest]]s: * {{ka|Silver Town}} Contest - Runner-Up (''[[AG151|Weekend Warrior]]'') ====Outfits==== File:Jeremy rocker.png|Jeremy in his {{tc|Guitarist|rocker}} outfit ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{grass color}}|bordercolor={{grass color light}} |ja=宇垣秀成 ''Hidenari Ugaki''
